notes.title: Patch notes Update 1.02
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
We have a quick update for you guys!

[h3]1.02 changelog (Don't need to reset save files)[/h3]

[b]Steam:[/b]
[olist]
[*] Added webm opening movie file for SteamOS users.
[*] Fixed an issue causing the game to crash when the game or save file path includes characters that are neither English nor Japanese.
[*] Added Windows 11 ARM support.
[/olist]
